{{Top|leg}}
'''Division Three Assault Troopers''' were [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] assigned to the [[Imperial Taxation Bureau]]'s [[Division Three]]. Assault Troopers were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]], [[Knife/Legends|knives]], and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. They wore [[Power armor/Legends|power armor]] to carry out their duties.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
